style: Soft, warm lifestyle photograph for a friendly everyday-life blog. Golden-hour window light, airy and cozy mood, light film grain, gentle pastel tones of cream, beige and sage green, natural wooden textures.
people: When people appear, show them relaxed and candid, often seen from the side or from behind, in casual clothing. No identifiable real people.
constraints: A single continuous photograph taken in one camera shot. No split panels, borders, collage or frames. No text, letters or numbers anywhere. No logos, brand packaging, watermarks or readable labels. Natural hands and faces.

title.design: Warm and approachable. Place the title in the calmest area of the image on a soft cream rounded rectangle with slight transparency, never covering a face. Main title in a dark brown rounded Japanese gothic typeface (maru gothic), bold; subtitle smaller in a muted sage green. If a small label is given, show it as a small sage-green tag above the main title. Centered or left-aligned, with plenty of breathing room.
